custom_field: প্রতি প্রশ্নের মান ১ ও ভুল উত্তরের জন্য ০.৫০ কাটা যাবে।

Vocabulary-Booster\t.question: ১) The word "Harbinger" means -
Vocabulary-Booster\t.option1: a sign of something to come
Vocabulary-Booster\t.option4: showing feelings that are too strong
Vocabulary-Booster\t.exp:
• Harbinger (Noun):
English Meaning: A sign that shows that something is going to happen soon, often something bad.
Bangla Meaning: অগ্রদূত, The cuckoo is a harbinger of spring.

• Synonyms: Omen (লক্ষণ), Sign (আলামত/ চিহ্ণ) Precursor(পূর্বাভাস) Signal (প্রতীক), Forerunner (অগ্রদূত)।

• Antonyms: Postdate (পরবর্তী সময়) Result (ফলাফল), Illuminate (আলোকিত করা, সন্দেহের অবসান), (পরবর্তী), End (শেষ), Finish (সমাপ্তি)।

• Other Forms: Harbinger (Verb)- Foreshadow or presage.

• Other Option:
• Hone (noun):
English Meaning:
- To develop and improve something, especially a skill, over a period of time.
Bangla Meaning: শান (-পাথর), পাথরে ঘষে ধার দেওয়া।

Enthrall (Verb transitive):
English Meaning: ​If something enthralls you, it is so interesting, beautiful, etc. that you give it all your attention.
Bangla Meaning:
- বিমুগ্ধ করা।

Fervid (adjective):
English Meaning: Feeling something too strongly; showing feelings that are too strong.
Bangla Meaning: উদ্দীপ্ত; ঐকান্তিক।

• Example Sentence:
1. The cuckoo is a harbinger of spring.
2. It was not a harbinger; it was a clear symptom of the move from a bipolar to a unipolar world.

Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

Vocabulary-Booster\t.question: ২) Synonym of "Frugal"-
Vocabulary-Booster\t.exp:
• Frugal (adjective):
English Meaning:
1. Using only as much money or food as is necessary.
2. (of meals) Small, plain and not costing very much.
Bangla Meaning: (বিশেষত খাদ্য, ব্যয় ইত্যাদি) সাবধান, মিতব্যয়ী, হিসাবি, সামান্য মূল্যের।

• Synonyms:
- Careful,
- Prudent,
- Stingy (সতর্ক, মিতব্যায়ী),
- Economical (মিতব্যায়ী, কম খরুচে),
- Heedful (সতর্ক)।

• Antonyms:
- Wasteful (অপব্যায়ী),
- Extravagant (অপচয়কারী),
- Generous (উদার),
- Spendthrift (প্রচুর টাকা পয়সা খরচকারী),
- Benevolent (উদার)।

• Other Forms:
- Frugally [ফ্রূগালি] (adverb) মিতব্যয়িতার সঙ্গে; হিসাব করে।
- Frugality [ফূগ্যালিটি] [noun] [uncountable noun, countable noun] মিতব্যয়িতা।

• Example Sentence:
1. He has always been hard-working and frugal.
2. His father was a frugal farmer.

Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

Vocabulary-Booster\t.question: ৩) What is the meaning of the word 'Jocular'?
Vocabulary-Booster\t.exp:
• Jocular (adjective):
English Meaning:
- humorous.
- enjoying making people laugh.
Bangla Meaning: রসিকতাপ্রিয়, রসিক।

• Synonyms:
- Cheerful (আনন্দমুখর),
- Jolly (প্রফুল্ল),
- Jovial (উৎফুল্ল),
- Amusing (চিত্তাকর্ষক),
- Comic (হাস্যকর)।

• Antonyms:
- Serious (গুরুগম্ভীর),
- Humourless (রসহীন),
- Gloomy (বিষণ্ন),
- Depressed (হতাশ),
- Demoralized (অবদমিত)।

• Other Forms:
- Jocularly (adverb).
- Jocularity (noun).

• Other Option:
• Far and away
English Meaning: by a very large amount.
Bangla Meaning: খুবই বেশি মাত্রায় / অতুলনীয়।
• Gain ground
English Meaning: become more popular or accepted / to make progress.
Bangla Meaning: জনপ্রিয় হওয়া বা গ্রহণযোগ্যতা পাওয়া / অগ্রসর হওয়া; উন্নতি করা।
• Half a chance
English Meaning: the slightest opportunity.
Bangla Meaning: ক্ষীণতম সুযোগ / কিছু সুযোগ।

• Example Sentence:
1. She explained in a jocular fashion that I was the problem.
2. She sighed and turned her head to look behind her and gave him a jovial smile.

Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

Vocabulary-Booster\t.question: ৪) The phrase "A man of letters" means-
Vocabulary-Booster\t.exp:
• A man of letters:
English Meaning: a male scholar or author.
Bangla Meaning: পণ্ডিত / বিদ্বান / লেখক।

Example Sentence: Dr. Shahidullah was a man of letters.
Bangla Meaning: ড. শহীদুল্লাহ একজন পণ্ডিত / বিদ্বান ব্যক্তি ছিলেন।

• Other option:
• At the outset:
English Meaning: the beginning.
Bangla Meaning: শুরুতেই / প্রারম্ভেই।

• At the root of:
English Meaning: the reason for (something).
Bangla Meaning: মূলে / কারণ।

• Bear fruit:
English Meaning: yield positive results.
Bangla Meaning: ফলপ্রদ হওয়া।

Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

Vocabulary-Booster\t.question: ৫) Complete the pair of Antonym- Glean :
Vocabulary-Booster\t.exp:
• Glean (verb intransitive), (verb transitive):
English Meaning: To obtain information, knowledge, etc., sometimes with difficulty and often from various places.
Bangla Meaning: ফসল তোলার পর মাঠে পড়ে থাকা শস্যদানা খুঁটে তোলা, ফসল কুড়ানো।

• Synonyms:
- Extract (টেনে বের করা বা একত্রে রাখা),
- Gather (একত্রিত করা),
- Collect (সংগ্রহ করা),
- Amass (জড়ো করা বা জমানো)
- Pick (গোছানো)।

• Antonyms:
- Disperse (সবদিকে ছড়িয়ে দেয়া),
- Divide (ভাগ করা),
- Spread (ছড়ানো),
- Scatter (বিক্ষিপ্ত করা),
- Disseminate (ছড়িয়ে দেয়া)।

• Other Forms:
- Gleaner (noun) (ফসল/খবর) কুড়ানি।
- Gleanings (noun) (plural) (সাধারণত লাক্ষণিক) বিভিন্ন উৎস থেকে আহরিত টুকরা জ্ঞানের কথা।

• Example Sentence:
1. These figures have been gleaned from a number of studies.
2. They were not to glean their fields for stray grain, nor harvest the corners.

Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

Vocabulary-Booster\t.question: ৬) Choose the correct spelling -
Vocabulary-Booster\t.exp:
• Haughty (adjective):
English Meaning: Behaving in an unfriendly way towards other people because you think that you are better than them.
Bangla Meaning: উদ্ধত; অহংকারী।

• Example Sentence:
1. He replied with haughty disdain.
2. This office is controlled by haughty aristocrats.

Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

Vocabulary-Booster\t.question: ৭) The noun form of "Pedantic"-
Vocabulary-Booster\t.exp:
• Pedant (noun):
English Meaning: A person who is too concerned with small details or rules especially when learning or teaching.
Bangla Meaning: যে ব্যক্তি পুঁথিগত বিদ্যা ও নিয়ম অনুশাসনের বিষয়ে অত্যন্ত কঠোর, গোঁড়া স্কুলশিক্ষক।

• Synonyms:
- Bookworm (বইপোকা),
- Egghead (জ্ঞানী),
- Scholastic (পন্ডিত),
- Intellectual (বুদ্ধিজীবী),
- Pedagogue (শিক্ষাগুরু)।

• Antonyms:
- Idiot (মাথামোটা),
- Moron (নির্বোধ),
- Blockhead (বোকা),
- Stupid (গর্দভ),
- Foolish (বোকা)।

• Other Forms:
- Pedantry (noun) [Uncountable noun] ক্লান্তিকর ও অপ্রয়োজনীয় পণ্ডিতিপনা; আনুষ্ঠানিকতা বিষয়ে অতিরিক্ত মনোযোগী, [Countable noun] এ ধরনের মনোযোগের বিষয়।
- Pedantic (adjective) পণ্ডিতি মনোভাবসুলভ।
- Pedantically (adverb).

• Example Sentence:
1. A pedant will always insist that you ask for ‘fewer’ items rather than ‘less’.
2. A pedant might ask if you really mean rocket propellants when you say rocket fuel.

Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

Vocabulary-Booster\t.question: ৮) Translate the Bengali proverb into English: "কয়লা ধুইলে ময়লা যায় না"।
Vocabulary-Booster\t.option1: As the wind blows you must set your sail.
Vocabulary-Booster\t.option2: An Ethiopian will not change his skin.
Vocabulary-Booster\t.option4: Birds of a feather flock together.
Vocabulary-Booster\t.exp:
• The proverb:
•" কয়লা ধুইলে ময়লা যায় না"।
English meaning: An Ethiopian will not change his skin.

• Other Option:
• As the wind blows you must set your sail.
Bengali meaning: সময় থাকতে কাজ গুছিয়ে নাও বা ঝোপ বুজে কোপ মারো।

• Barking dogs seldom bite.
Bengali meaning: যত গর্জে তত বর্ষে না।

• Birds of a feather flock together.
Bengali meaning: চোরে চোরে মাসতুতো ভাই।

Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

Vocabulary-Booster\t.question: ৯) He claimed that he was happy, but he was thinking _____ of quitting his job.
Vocabulary-Booster\t.exp:
• All the while:
English Meaning: during the entire time / for all of a period of time.
Bangla Meaning: সাারাক্ষণই / পুরোটা সময় জুড়ে।

Exaple Sentence: He claimed that he was happy, but he was thinking all the while of quitting his job.
Bangla Meaning: সে বলছিলো সে এখানে খুশি আছে অথচ পুরোটা সময় জুড়ে সে আসলে চাকরিটা ছাড়ার কথা ভাবছিলো।

• Other Option:
• Be in deep water:
English Meaning: to be in or get into serious trouble.
Bangla Meaning: অথৈ জলে পড়া / খুব বিপদে পড়া।

• Be six feet under:
English Meaning: to be dead and buried.
Bangla Meaning: মৃত ও সমাহিত।

• Below the belt:
English Meaning: disregarding the rules / unfair.
Bangla Meaning: অন্যায়ভাবে।

Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

Vocabulary-Booster\t.question: ১০) Which of the following is synonymous with the word "Fervid"?
Vocabulary-Booster\t.exp:
• Fervid (adjective):
English Meaning: Feeling something too strongly; showing feelings that are too strong.
Bangla Meaning: উদ্দীপ্ত, ঐকান্তিক।

• Synonyms:
- Ardent (প্রবল, আকুল),
- Impassioned (প্রবল আবেগপ্রবণ),
- Vehement (ব্যগ্রভাবে),
- Fervent (উগ্র),
- Intense(তীব্র)।

• Antonyms:
- Dispassionate (নিরাসক্ত),
- Half Hearted (শিথিল উদ্যম),
- Emotionless (আবেগহীন),
- Passionless (অনুভূতিহীন),
- Cold (ঠান্ডা)।

• Other Forms: - Fervidly (adverb).

• Example Sentence:
1. Imagine a country with no McDonald's, Burger King, Wendy's or any other fervid fryers of French fries.
2. Margaret Mary again mentions the fervid fire that felt like it would consume her.

Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

Vocabulary-Booster\t.question: ১১) The right antonym of "Lope" is-
Vocabulary-Booster\t.exp:
• Lope (verb intransitive):
English Meaning: A way of running with long relaxed steps.
Bangla Meaning: (খরগোশের মতো) লাফিয়ে লাফিয়ে চলা।।

• Synonyms:
- Bounce (তিড়িং লাফ),
- To Jump (লাফানো),
- Gallop (দ্রুতগতিতে অগ্রসর হওয়া),
- Trot (দুলকি চাল),
- Canter (আস্তে আস্তে যাওয়া)।

• Antonyms:
- Crawl (হামাগুড়ি দেয়া),
- Slow (ধীরে অগ্রসর হওয়া),
- Halt (থামা),
- Creep (হামাগুড়ি),
- Walk (হাঁটা)।

• Other Forms: (noun) এরকমের উল্লম্ফন।

• Example Sentence:
1. He gestured to his friend to hurry over, and Hank broke into a lope.
2. He sets off at a measured lope, headed toward the Great Divide, headed east.

Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

Vocabulary-Booster\t.question: ১২) 'Wile' means-
Vocabulary-Booster\t.option1: The use of tricks to deceive someone
Vocabulary-Booster\t.option2: A way of running with long relaxed steps.
Vocabulary-Booster\t.option3: To shake your head from side to side.
Vocabulary-Booster\t.option4: To drink so that you no longer feel thirsty.
Vocabulary-Booster\t.exp:
• Wile (noun):
English Meaning: The use of tricks to deceive someone (usually to extract money from them).
Bangla Meaning: (সাধারণত plural) কূটকৌশল, চাতুরী, শয়তানি।

• Synonyms:
- Trickery (ছলচাতুরী করা),
- Cunning (কূটকৌশল),
- Cheating (ধান্দাবাজি),
- Artifice (চালাকি),
- Betraying (প্রতারণা করা)।

• Antonyms:
- Frankness (নির্ভীকতা),
- Honesty (সততা),
- Openness (স্বচ্ছতা),
- Candidness (সরলতা),
- Straightness (অকপটতা)।

• Other Forms:
- Denigration [ডেনিগ্রেইশ্‌ন্‌] (noun) মানহানি; কালিমা লেপন।

• Example Sentence:
1. His wit and wile has made him one of the sharpest politicians in the Cabinet.
2. The wiles of the Devil. She fell a victim to the wiles of that unscrupulous rogue.

• Other Option:
- Lope: A way of running with long relaxed steps.
- Wag: To shake your head from side to side.
- Slake: To drink so that you no longer feel thirsty.

Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

Vocabulary-Booster\t.question: ১৩) What is the Bengali meaning of the proverb "A sleeping fox catches no poultry"?
Vocabulary-Booster\t.option1: যেমনি বুনো ওল, তেমনি বাঘা তেঁতুল।
Vocabulary-Booster\t.option2: চেনা বামুনের পৈতার দরকার হয় না।
Vocabulary-Booster\t.option4: অলস লোক জীবনে কোনোকাজ করতে পারে না।
Vocabulary-Booster\t.exp:
• The proverb:
• "A sleeping fox catches no poultry".
Bengali meaning: অলস লোক জীবনে কোনোকাজ করতে পারে না।

• Other Option:
• Adversity often leads to prosperity.
Bengali meaning: দুঃখের পরিণতি সুখে।

• As is the evil so is the remedy.
Bengali meaning: যেমনি বুনো ওল, তেমনি বাঘা তেঁতুল।

• Good wine needs no bush.
Bengali meaning: চেনা বামুনের পৈতার দরকার হয় না।

Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

Vocabulary-Booster\t.question: ১৪) What is the meaning of the phrase "At daggers drawn"?
Vocabulary-Booster\t.exp:
• At daggers drawn:
English Meaning: at enmity / in a state of open hostility or conflict.
Bangla Meaning: শত্রুতা / খড়গহস্ত।

Example Sentence: Two brothers are now at daggers drawn about the house.
Bangla Meaning: বাড়ি নিয়ে দুই ভাইয়ের মধ্যে এখন গভীর শত্রুতা।

• Other Option:
• By all means:
English Meaning: of course / certainly (granting a permission).
Bangla Meaning: খুব আগ্রহের সাথে অনুমতি দেওয়া বুঝাতে ; অবশ্যই, নিশ্চয়ই।

• By and by:
English Meaning: before long / eventually / ultimately / shortly.
Bangla Meaning: অবশেষে / অনতিকাল মধ্যে / অবিলম্বে / দেখতে দেখতে।

• Castles in the air:
English Meaning: visionary unattainable schemes / daydreams.
Bangla Meaning: আকাশ কুসুম কল্পনা / অবাস্তব কল্পনা।

Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

Vocabulary-Booster\t.question: ১৫) Choose the synonym of "Pariah"-
Vocabulary-Booster\t.exp:
• Pariah (noun) [uncountable noun]:
English Meaning: A person who is not acceptable to society and is avoided by everyone.
Bangla Meaning: (ভারত) নিচু জাতের লোক; অস্পৃশ্য লোক; (লাক্ষণিক) সমাজচ্যুত ব্যক্তি।

• Synonyms:
- Outcast (সমাজচ্যুত),
- Outsider (বহিরাগত, আগন্তক),
- Exile (নির্বাসিত),
- Vagabond (ভবঘুরে)।

• Antonyms:
- Friend (বন্ধু),
- Insider (ঘরের লোক),
- Included (অন্তর্ভুক্ত),
- Loved (প্রিয়),
- Favorite (প্রিয়)।

• Other Forms: Pariah-dog (noun) (ভারত) মালিকহীন মিশ্রজাতের কুকুর।

• Example Sentence:
1. In this modern age of cynicism and celebrity the road from pariah to popularity is a short one.
2. In this modern age of cynicism and celebrity the road from pariah to popularity is a short one.

Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

Vocabulary-Booster\t.question: ১৬) The house was spacious but without any trace of ostentation. The word "ostentation" in this sentence is a/an-
Vocabulary-Booster\t.exp:
• Ostentation (noun):
English Meaning: An exaggerated display of wealth, knowledge or skill that is made in order to impress people.
Bangla Meaning: প্রশংসালাভ বা ঈর্ষা জাগ্রত করার জন্য (বিত্ত, বিদ্যা, দক্ষতা ইত্যাদির) প্রদর্শন: The ostentation of the newly rich.

• Synonyms:
- Display(প্রদর্শনেচ্ছা্),
- Boast (লোক দেখানো),
- Brag (বড়াই),
- Fuss (হড়বড়ি),
- Bluster (তর্জন-গর্জন)।

• Antonyms:
- Modesty (নম্রতা),
- Simplicity (সরলতা),
- Concealment (সৌজন্যতা, ঢেকে রাখা),
- Humbleness (বিনয়),
- Dullness (নিস্তেজতা)।

• Other Forms: Ostentate (Verb).

• Example Sentence:
1. The house was spacious but without any trace of ostentation.
2. ‍She is a charming host without any touch of stiffness or ostentation.

Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

Vocabulary-Booster\t.question: ১৭) Pick the option which is not synonymous with the word "Wag"
Vocabulary-Booster\t.exp:
• Wag (verb transitive), (verb intransitive):
English Meaning:
- Wag (something) if a dog wags its tail, or its tail wags, its tail moves from side to side several times.
- To shake your finger or your head from side to side or up and down, often because you do not approve of something.
Bangla Meaning: (wagged, wagging, wags) (লেজ ইত্যাদি) নড়া, নাড়া: a wagging tail.

• Synonyms:
- Shake (নাড়ানো),
- Nod (মাথা ঘুরানো),
- Waggle (আলোড়ন),
- Release (মুক্তি)।

• Antonyms:
- Be still (অবিচল),
- Freeze (স্থির),
- Suspend (সাসপেন্ড)।

• Other Forms:
- Wag (noun).রসিক/আমুদে/ফুর্তিবাজ/রগুড়ে লোক।
- Waggish [ওয়্যাগিশ্] (adjective) রগুড়ে/আমুদে, সকৌতুক: wagish remarks/tricks.
- Waggishly (adverb) পরিহাসচ্ছলে, রগড়চ্ছলে ইত্যাদি।

• Example Sentence:
1. Just remember what I said,’ she repeated, wagging her finger at him.
2. The happy dog wagged his tail.

Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

Vocabulary-Booster\t.question: ১৮) Identify the correct spelling-
Vocabulary-Booster\t.exp:
• Telltale (adjective):
English Meaning:
- Disclosing unintentionally something concealed.
- showing that something exists or has happened
Bangla Meaning: গোপনকথা ফাঁসকারী।

• Synonyms: 
- Revealing (কথার ফাঁকে গোপন কথা ফাঁস করা, উন্মোচন করা),
- Blabber (অনর্থক কথা বলা),
- Chatter (আগড়ম বাগড়ম),
- Cackle (বোকার মত বকবক করা)। 

• Antonyms:
- Uninformative (তথ্যবিহীন),
- Unrevealing (অপ্রকাশ্য),
- Uninstructive (অনির্দেশক),
- Unhelpful (সাহায্য করবে না এমন),
- Useless (অকেজো)।

• Other Forms:
- Telltale (Noun): Someone who gossips indiscreetly.
- Telltalely (Adverb).

• Example Sentence:
1. The telltale smell of cigarettes told her that he had been in the room.
2. His feet are swollen, and his skin cracked, both telltale signs of malnutrition.

Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

Vocabulary-Booster\t.question: ১৯) Which word means the opposite of "Rabble"?
Vocabulary-Booster\t.exp:
• Rabble (noun):
English Meaning:
- A large group of noisy people who are or may become violent.
- Ordinary people or people who are considered to have a low social position.
Bangla Meaning: উচ্ছৃঙ্খল জনতা।

• Synonyms:
- The Masses (সাধারণ জনতা),
- Mob (ভীড়, সাধারণ লোক),
- Public (সাধারণ জনগন),
- Commoners (নিচু জাতের মানুষ)
- Crowd (জনতা, সাধারণ মানুষ)।

• Antonyms:
- Aristocracy (সম্ভ্রান্ত),
- Nobility (শরীফ),
- Elite (বিশেষ সুবিধাপ্রাপ্ত শ্রেণী),
- Upper class, (উচ্চবিত্ত,)
- Chosen (নির্বাচিত বিশেষ শ্রেণীর মানুষ)।

• Other Forms:
- Rabble-rousing (Adjective)

• Example Sentence:
1. He was met by a rabble of noisy, angry youths.
2. The truth is they represent the interests of a bigoted, rich and reactionary rabble.

Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

Vocabulary-Booster\t.question: ২০) What is a synonym for "Coax"?
Vocabulary-Booster\t.exp:
• Coax (verb transitive), (verb intransitive):
English Meaning:
- To persuade somebody to do something by talking to them in a kind and gentle way.
- Coax somebody/something (into doing something) She coaxed the horse into coming a little closer.
- Coax somebody/something (into/out of something) He was coaxed out of retirement to help the failing company.
- Coax somebody/something ( adv./prep.) Police managed to coax the man down from the ledge.
(figurative) She had to coax the car along.
- Coax (somebody/something) + speech ‘Nearly there,’ she coaxed.
- Coax somebody/something (to do something) She gently coaxes them to speak about their experiences.
Bangla Meaning: মিষ্ট কথায় ভুলানো, প্রলুব্ধ করা।

• Synonyms:
- Entice (প্রলুব্ধ করা), 
- Flatter (তেলতেলে কথা বলা),
- Badger (জ্বালাতন করা),
- Lure (পটানো, টোপ দেয়া)।

• Antonyms:
- Discourage (নিরুৎসাহিত করা),
- Repel (বিতাড়ন),
- Disgust (বিরক্তি),
- Admonish (তিরষ্কার করা),
- Caution (সতর্কবার্তা)।

• Other Forms: Coaxing (Noun).

• Example Sentence:
1. He took a lot of coaxing before he agreed to take her to the theatre.
2. He coaxed her into going along.

Source: Live MCQ Lecture.
